code.description: Machine-readable failure discriminant, present only when the handler set one (e.g. `extension_refresh_invalid`, `invalid`). Absent for generic validation/guard errors.

error.description: Short error class name (Nest default), e.g. `Bad Request`, `Unauthorized`.

message.description: Human-readable message. A single string for most errors; an array of strings when the global ValidationPipe reports one entry per failed constraint.

path.description: Request path the error occurred on.

request_id.description: Correlation id from RequestIdMiddleware; omitted when absent.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code, echoed in the body.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant the error envelope was built.

message.description: Generic backoff message (never echoes input or which limit fired).
message.example: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying; matches the `Retry-After` header.

committed.description: Entities actually committed (proof, not an estimate).

already_present_verified.description: Verified already present (S9); null until known.

canonical_family.description: Canonical family the staged token resolves to (S9); null when unmapped or when the token resolves to different families across platforms. Present only when a report applies.

completeness_basis.description: Completeness basis for the family (S9 D-S9-3): 'none' until a basis is recorded. Present only when a report applies.

created_native.description: Native rows created (S9); null until known.

native_present_verified.description: Verified natively present (created or already present) identities (S9 D-S9-4). Present only when a report applies.

observed_unique.description: Observed by the extension (S10); null until known.

qualifiers.description: Family qualifiers (D-S9-5, closed enum, append-only); present only when a report applies.

reasons.description: Closed-catalogue reason histogram over the staged identities (S9 D-S9-7), sorted by code. Present only when a report applies.

rejected.description: Rejected by reconciliation (S9); null until known.

relationship_closure.description: Relationship closure over the verified identities (S9 D-S9-5): not_applicable = no verified identity carries a declared edge. Present only when a report applies.

staged_unique.description: Distinct staged source identities for the family.

unresolved.description: Unresolved by reconciliation (S9); null until known.

code.description: Reason code from the closed S9 catalogue (never free text).

count.description: Identities of the family carrying this code.

accepted_start_at.description: Server-owned start of a server run (written once at Start); null on legacy rows.

claimed_status.description: The extension's stored /complete claim (`success|partial|failed`); null while none. On a server run this is INPUT to the arbiter, never the terminal itself.

deadline_at.description: accepted_start_at + SCOUT_RUN_DEADLINE_MS; enforced lazily. Null on legacy rows.

execution_epoch.description: Fence epoch of the run (1 until fenced).

families.description: Per-family evidence: staged unique rows and the reconstruction ledger tally. Native buckets are null (= not yet known, never 0) until later slices fill them.

intent_id.description: The intent id that was read.

last_observed_at.description: Last write accepted through the run gate; null on legacy rows.

mode.description: `server` for a run started via POST /scout/runs/start; `legacy` otherwise.

phase.description: Open-run phase of a server run; null on legacy rows and once terminal.

reason_code.description: Why the server run reached its terminal; null while open and on legacy rows.

started_at.description: Earliest evidence timestamp (ISO-8601): first committed entity, else lifecycle start, else latest progress snapshot. Null when none timestamped. For a settled run with zero committed entities and no snapshot this degenerates to the settle-time lifecycle start, so it may equal completed_at.

reconstructed.description: Entities mapped to a roster Person.

staged.description: Staged client entities considered for this intent.

limit.description: Page size applied to this response.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page.

display_name.description: Display name for the roster row, if the source provided one.

source_person_id.description: Source platform's own record id (provenance, not a canonical key).

state.description: Lifecycle state of the roster record.

persons.description: Reconstructed invite-pending roster rows for this page (deterministic order).

roster_bridge_pending.description: Always true for now: these rows are the interim reconstructed Person bridge, not native coach-roster clients or principals. Imported clients stay absent from the User-based roster until the S8-D bridge is accepted. Present on empty pages too.

bearer.description: Supabase-issued JWT. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are verified against the Supabase JWKS in JwtAuthGuard.

400.description: Invalid query string (global ValidationPipe: whitelist + forbidNonWhitelisted). Raised when `intent_id` is missing, empty, over 128 chars, or an unknown query param is supplied. Standard HttpExceptionFilter envelope; `message` is a string ARRAY of per-field constraint violations when present.

403.description: Caller is not a coach or owner.

404.description: Uniform not-found. Returned identically whether FEATURE_SCOUT_INGEST is off (R-DARK-1 dark route, decided before any guard runs) OR the run has no server-side evidence for the calling coach (unknown intent, cross-tenant intent, or a run with no committed entity, persisted progress snapshot, or settle row yet). The two cases are deliberately indistinguishable — no existence oracle.

get.summary: Read one import run's server-authoritative status (committed counts, not estimates)

get.description: Returns the invite-pending roster Person records reconstructed from one settled crawl intent, joined to the reconstruction ledger, with honest accounting { staged, reconstructed, skipped, failed } and deterministic, bounded cursor pagination. Excludes deleted and cross-tenant rows; never returns email or billing fields. Returns 404 when the intent is unknown for the caller or when the scout flags are off. The response carries roster_bridge_pending: true (also on empty pages): these are interim Person bridge rows, not native roster clients or principals, until the S8-D bridge is accepted. Only person-kind ledger rows are materialized here.

parameters.description: The settled crawl intent whose reconstructed roster to read.
parameters.name: intent_id

parameters.description: Opaque forward-only page cursor returned as `page.next_cursor` by a prior call. Omit for the first page. Accepts legacy and scoped v2 tokens; emits scoped v2. A malformed cursor, or a legacy cursor that no longer resolves to one reconstructed row, is a 400 (fail closed): restart pagination from the first page.
parameters.name: cursor

400.description: Invalid query (missing/oversized intent_id, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor, including a legacy cursor that no longer resolves — restart from the first page). Standard HttpExceptionFilter envelope.

404.description: Uniform not-found: the flags are off (R-DARK-1) OR the intent has no ScoutImport evidence for the calling coach (unknown or cross-tenant). The two are deliberately indistinguishable — no existence oracle.

get.summary: Read a settled intent's reconstructed invite-pending roster
